maya_ops: Started the driver rollout to us-west pool at 02:00 UTC last night (530.41 -> 555.12). Canary job for search-embed failed on 2/5 canaries with TensorRT plugin errors. attaching quick logs. :grimacing:
leon_infra: Ugh. Which instance types? A100 or H100?
zara_ml: A100 for that pool. Error looks like plugin symbol mismatch in libnvinfer_plugin.so. Here is snippet:
```
ImportError: /opt/trt/lib/libnvinfer_plugin.so: undefined symbol: _ZN10nvinfer4plugin13PluginCreator...
2026-03-17 02:14:11 [ERROR] flash_attn kernel launch failed: unspecified launch failure
```
maya_ops: Exactly. Also seeing repeated `cuda api error: kernel launch failed` in xformers-backed models.
ashley_sre: Deploy-bot shows rollout was staged to 40% before auto-canary tried traffic. deploy-bot: `rollout paused — failure threshold exceeded`
deploy-bot: rollouts/17789 paused by auto-canary (err rate 12.4% > 5%).
ben_prod: Are NCCL hangs showing anywhere? We had a spike in cross-node allreduce timeouts around the same window.
ops-bot: NCCL WARN: recv collision, 2s timeout, ranks lost: 0-3
leon_infra: That points to mixed-driver/hw ABI incompat across nodes. Did the kernel-level driver (nvidia.ko) corrresponding to 555 get loaded everywhere?
maya_ops: Nope — some hosts still on old kernel module (we had a failed kube-drain on a few nodes). So mixed-driver state likely.
zara_ml: Mixed state explains undefined symbol — trt plugins were built against 530 libs present on some hosts but the module ABI changed.
ashley_sre: Short term: pausing rollout and pinning hosts back to 530 on affected nodegroup. Can we force unschedule on remaining 555 nodes?
leon_infra: I'll run `kubectl cordon` + drain for the 555 nodes and trigger a repair job to revert the driver package. Command I'll use:
```sh
sudo apt-get install --allow-downgrades nvidia-driver-530 -y
sudo reboot
```
maya_ops: Also we should add a compatibility check in the rollout playbook: validate libnvinfer version + xformers/trt plugin symbol table before sending traffic.
ben_prod: Traffic routing note: us-west pool is 70% of throughput for embeddings at peak. If we pull capacity to downgrade, latency will rise and run-rate costs may spike because other regions don't have spare A100s.
zara_ml: For longer term: rebuild the TRT/xformers wheels against 555 toolchain (or build them as manylinux-like with bundled TRT plugins) so they are forward-compatible. That needs CI changes and NVIDIA plugin headers pinned in build infra.
leon_infra: I'll open infra ticket and vendor escalation with NV. Ticket INFRA-1427 created. Adding logs and node list.
ashley_sre: Can we set smart routing fallback to eu-central for embeddings for the next 4 hours? We have spare cap there but cross-region egress cost will apply.
ben_prod: Yes but we need product signoff; doing fallback adds ~18% egress cost and some SLO risk for APAC users. Ops prefers gradual traffic shift 10% every 10m.
maya_ops: Agreed. Action items: 1) pin rollback on affected nodegroup (leon). 2) pause rollout globally (deploy-bot already paused). 3) start canary rebuild of trt/xformers against 555 in CI (zara). 4) enable routing fallback to eu-central at 10% increments (ashley/ben). 5) NV vendor escalation and tracking (leon).
ops-bot: NOTE: automated mitigation recommended: add `LD_PRELOAD=/usr/local/lib/compat_trt.so` workaround only if validated in canary.
zara_ml: I'll validate LD_PRELOAD trick on a canary if we can get a representative A100 image on 555 driver. Might be quick but not guaranteed.
leon_infra: Rolling those steps now. I'll post node lists and ETA.
ben_prod: Keep product in loop. I'll prepare a brief for customer-facing comms if we need to widen the rollback window.
maya_ops: Thanks team. If anyone sees a new region showing increased NCCL timeouts, ping here. I'll update INFRA-1427 with timeline and followups. :thumbsup:
